thag3.3:1.1: Yo pubbe karaṇīyāni pacchā so kātum icchati, sukhā so dhaṃsate ṭhānā pacchā cam anutappati. || ||
thag3.3:2.1: yañ hi kayirā tañ hi vade, yaṃ na kayirā na taṃ vade. akarontaṃ bhāsamānaṃ parijānanti paṇḍitā. || ||
thag3.3:3.1: susukhaṃ vata nibbānaṃ sammāsambuddhadesitaṃ asokaṃ virajaṃ khemaṃ yattha dukkhaṃ nirujjhatīti. || || Bākulathero.
